about_short_description.short_description: Virgio is a global D2C fast fashion brand which offers Trendy, Elegant and Affordable styles to it's fashion forward users.

product.name: Sustainable Women's Fashion Apparel
product.description: A range of women's clothing made from eco-friendly fabrics including recycled polyester, linen, organic cotton, and viscose, designed for everyday and special occasions.

product.name: Smart Tag Technology
product.description: A digital tag attached to each garment providing environmental impact data and styling information to consumers.

product.name: Eco-Friendly Packaging
product.description: Packaging materials for products that are biodegradable, plastic-free, and reusable to reduce environmental waste.

product.name: Data-Driven Design and Manufacturing Process
product.description: A technology-driven approach using data analytics to optimize design, manufacturing, and purchasing to reduce overproduction and waste.
